challenge.name: The Consent Void
challenge.description: A legal audit flagged that loyalty basket data lacks valid consent records, breaking the legal basis for using it in forecasts. #requirements_reuben# demands the data contracts be fully automated and governed to enforce consent checks before any data enters the pipeline. #efficiency_emilia# argues that manual review is sufficient for now to avoid delaying the promotion planning cycle, though she might accept a middle ground if it does not stall the weekly leaflet.

output.content: The audit results confirm that our current handling of loyalty basket data is non compliant. We need to move past manual spot checks and implement fully governed data contracts. These contracts must automatically verify valid consent records before any personal data enters the forecasting pipeline. The goal is to eliminate the risk of processing data without a legal basis. We should aim for a system where consent enforcement is baked into the data ingestion layer, ensuring that every record is validated at the source. This approach will provide the strongest possible guarantee that our forecasts remain compliant as we scale. I want us to prioritize this architectural shift to secure the integrity of our data foundation.
output.reclassify_reason: The text explicitly states a goal to eliminate risk and secure data integrity, and prioritizing this architectural shift would make the author happier by achieving the strongest possible compliance guarantee.
